steps.expression: const t = input.scope.fetch_ticket_details.data; const f = t.fields || {}; const desc = (f.description && f.description.content && f.description.content[0] && f.description.content[0].content && f.description.content[0].content[0]) ? f.description.content[0].content[0].text : undefined; return { key: t.key, summary: f.summary, description: desc, assignee: f.assignee ? f.assignee.displayName : undefined, status: f.status ? f.status.name : undefined, priority: f.priority ? f.priority.name : undefined, type: f.issuetype ? f.issuetype.name : undefined, components: (f.components || []).map((c) => c.name), created: f.created, updated: f.updated };
